title: Differentials vs True Change Delta y
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For y = 3x^2 - 5x + 2, compute dy and compare with Delta y when x changes from 2 to 2.01.

steps.title: Compute Differential dy
steps.explanation: Substitute x = 2 and dx = 0.01 into dy = f'(x)dx.

steps.title: Compute True Change Delta y
steps.explanation: Calculate exact difference between function values.

steps.title: Compare Accuracy
steps.explanation: The differential approximates Delta y to within 3 parts in ten thousand.
steps.why: Demonstrates that dy is the principal linear part of Delta y.
